direction: Preserve the continuous conversation layout and existing typography; make tool output readable and consistent with HeroUI interactions.
changes: Use HeroUI Disclosure for tools and Thinking, with matching row geometry, focus feedback and disclosure indicators.
Use HeroUI Spinner; interrupted tools have a pause icon instead of a success check.
Namespace Prism token classes with syntax- to prevent HeroUI Tag CSS collisions; retain inline, selectable code and source-language highlighting for diffs.
Stabilize tool callbacks and Markdown renderers so streaming updates do not invalidate every historical message solely through callback identity.
Increase Nord dark muted color from #616e88 to #a5b0c2; filename uses primary text and tool verbs remain secondary.
Keep replies following tool output at normal body text size and color.
Include command-chip baseline offset and remove-button footprint in editor scrollport padding, removing short-draft scrollbars.
Prevent unfocused editor repaint from restoring selection and stealing focus from conversation controls.
motion: HeroUI disclosure height/opacity transitions; shared 160ms arrow rotation and 120ms hover feedback. Existing message entry and stream caret retained; existing reduced-motion overrides apply.
removed_text: Removed the duplicate running label from each active tool row; the action verb, loading indicator and conversation running status retain the state.

coverage: Copy feedback and preserved code text
User expansion choice across stream delta and tool completion
visual: CSS zoom 2 at 1280x1100, respecting the original 480px minimum app height
810x366 focused preview using the production Conversation component

independent_review.result: No visible blocking issues or required refinements in reviewed desktop, narrow-window, expanded-Thinking and 200% screenshots.
independent_review.preserve: Continuous conversation without avatars, aligned lightweight tool rows, primary filenames, contained code wrapping and separate composer metadata.

limitations: Browser preview uses fixture data and the real stream reducer; no live model-provider session was started.
Copy feedback and original code text were verified; the host clipboard readback channel returned empty text, so system clipboard contents were not verified.
No motion recording was available through the host browser tools; transitions were exercised through interaction and screenshots.
No production build or full test suite was run, following the UI task scope.
